Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. figures.finding: Salaries are taxed monthly at 0% to LAK 2,500,000, 5% to 5,000,000, 10% to 15,000,000, 15% to 25,000,000, 20% to 65,000,000 and 25% above (Law No. 88/NA art. 38(1)), the bands to move with the minimum wage the Government sets; PwC annualises the scale at 0% to 30 million up to 25% above 780 million. Sole traders and independent contractors pay profit tax on business income instead.
figures.applies: Lao and foreign individuals, 2026: the law's own monthly table, read 2026-11-03 in the Official Gazette's scan, is the one the PwC summary gave, and the game counts it over twelve months.

sources.said: All sole traders and independent contractors are subject to profit tax (PT) on their business income derived in Lao PDR.

figures.finding: PIT is computed monthly; employees now file an annual return by 31 March of the following year.

sources.said: Employees are now required to obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and file annual PIT returns by 31 March of the following year.

figures.finding: Social security is 5.5% from the employee and 6% from the employer on gross pay, on a base capped at LAK 4.5 million a month; expatriates working over 12 months must register.

sources.said: 6% of the gross remuneration must be contributed by the employer. 5.5% of the gross remuneration must be contributed by the employee.
the total base amount to be calculated is capped at LAK 4.5 million.

figures.finding: The employer withholds salary tax monthly and pays it by the 20th of the next month (art. 39). Sports and performing-arts income above the minimum wage the Government sets bears 5% of the whole of it (art. 38(4.4)), and income from intellectual property such as copyright 5% (art. 38(4.3)); commissions, consultancy and other service fees bear 10% (art. 38(5.6)).

value.artistsAbove: the minimum wage the Government sets

figures.applies: Law No. 88/NA (25 June 2025), which replaced Law No. 67/NA of 2019, read 2026-11-03. Art. 74 puts it in force from 1 September 2025 once the President's promulgating decree is issued and it is published in the Official Gazette; the Gazette published it on 19 June 2026, and law firms report 1 July 2026; no Tax Department notice settles which. Either way it is in force for 2026, and the game's withholding isn't dated, so it withholds 5% from a performer's fee all year. The 10% the PwC summary gave was the 2019 law's. The minimum wage under which a performer's fee bears none isn't read, so the game withholds from every fee.

sources.said: Employers must withhold the PIT payable from their employees' salaries each month and submit the PIT declaration and payment before the 20th (previously 15th) day of the following month.
4.4 ການເຄື່ອນໄຫວກິລາ-ກາຍຍະກຳ, ສິລະປະການສະແດງ ເກີນຄ່າແຮງງານຂັ້ນຕ່ຳ ທີ່ລັດຖະບານກຳນົດ

figures.finding: A non-resident's pay as an artist, an athlete or a committee member bears 10% of the whole (Law No. 88/NA art. 48(2.1)), copyright fees 5% (art. 48(3.2)), and salaries the residents' scale (art. 48(1)); the payer withholds it. Whether it is final isn't stated.

sources.said: Expatriates who work in Lao PDR and obtain remuneration in Lao PDR are obligated to pay PIT, regardless of the period of their employment and stay in Lao PDR.
WHT is applied to various types of payments made to domestic and foreign recipients.
2.1 ຄ່າຕອບແທນແກ່ ຄະນະກຳມະການ, ສິລະປິນ, ນັກກິລາ-ກາຍຍະກຳ ແລະ ຜູ້ອື່ນ

figures.finding: VAT is 10%; the law sets no turnover threshold: a person registered as an enterprise, with a taxpayer number and a business licence, must enter VAT (Law No. 60/NA art. 33), and micro-enterprises' entry is left to a separate regulation, not found.

sources.said: The standard VAT rate is 10%.

sources.title: Law on Income Tax (amended) No. 88/NA of 25 June 2025, Lao Official Gazette (Ministry of Justice), entry 2597, published in the Gazette on 19-06-2026 (scan, read against the page images)
sources.said: ມາດຕາ 38 (ປັບປຸງ) ອັດຕາອາກອນລາຍໄດ້ … 1. ອັດຕາທະວີຄູນ ແຕ່ ສູນສ່ວນຮ້ອຍ (0%) ຫາ ຊາວຫ້າສ່ວນຮ້ອຍ (25%) … ແຕ່ 2,500,000 ລົງມາ 0%; ເກີນ 2,500,000 ຫາ 5,000,000 5%; ເກີນ 5,000,000 ຫາ 15,000,000 10%; ເກີນ 15,000,000 ຫາ 25,000,000 15%; ເກີນ 25,000,000 ຫາ 65,000,000 20%; ເກີນ 65,000,000 25% … 4. ອັດຕາ ຫ້າສ່ວນຮ້ອຍ (5%) ຂອງລາຍໄດ້ທັງໝົດ ສຳລັບ: … 4.3 ຊັບສິນທາງປັນຍາ ເຊັ່ນ ລິຂະສິດ, ສິດທິບັດ, ເຄື່ອງໝາຍການຄ້າ ຫຼື ສິດອື່ນ ຂອງ ບຸກຄົນ ຫຼື ນິຕິບຸກຄົນ; 4.4 ການເຄື່ອນໄຫວກິລາ-ກາຍຍະກຳ, ສິລະປະການສະແດງ ເກີນຄ່າແຮງງານຂັ້ນຕ່ຳ ທີ່ລັດຖະບານກຳນົດ; … 5. ອັດຕາ ສິບສ່ວນຮ້ອຍ (10%) ຂອງລາຍໄດ້ທັງໝົດ ສຳລັບ: … 5.6 ລາຍໄດ້ຈາກ ຄ່ານາຍໜ້າ, ຄ່າທີ່ປຶກສາ ແລະ ຄ່າບໍລິການອື່ນ; … ມາດຕາ 39 … ບໍ່ໃຫ້ກາຍ ວັນທີ 20 ຂອງເດືອນຖັດໄປ … ມາດຕາ 48 (ປັບປຸງ) … 2. ອັດຕາ ສິບສ່ວນຮ້ອຍ (10%) ຂອງລາຍໄດ້ທັງໝົດ ສຳລັບ: 2.1 ຄ່າຕອບແທນແກ່ ຄະນະກຳມະການ, ສິລະປິນ, ນັກກິລາ-ກາຍຍະກຳ ແລະ ຜູ້ອື່ນ; … 3. ອັດຕາ ຫ້າສ່ວນຮ້ອຍ (5%) ຂອງລາຍໄດ້ທັງໝົດ ສຳລັບ: … 3.2 ຄ່າລິຂະສິດ, ສິດທິບັດ, ເຄື່ອງໝາຍການຄ້າ; … ມາດຕາ 50 … ບໍ່ໃຫ້ກາຍວັນທີ 31 ມີນາ ຂອງປີຖັດໄປ … ມາດຕາ 74 (ປັບປຸງ) ຜົນສັກສິດ ກົດໝາຍສະບັບນີ້ ມີຜົນສັກສິດ ນັບແຕ່ວັນທີ 1 ກັນຍາ 2025 ພາຍຫຼັງ ປະທານປະເທດ ແຫ່ງ ສາທາລະນະລັດ ປະຊາທິປະໄຕ ປະຊາຊົນລາວ ອອກລັດຖະດຳລັດ ປະກາດໃຊ້ ແລະ ໄດ້ລົງຈົດໝາຍເຫດທາງລັດຖະການ ເປັນຕົ້ນໄປ. [Art. 38: 1, the monthly scale (LAK) 0% to 2.5 million, 5% to 5 million, 10% to 15 million, 15% to 25 million, 20% to 65 million, 25% above; 4, 5% of total income on 4.3 intellectual property such as copyright, patents, trademarks or other rights, and on 4.4 sports and performing-arts activity above the minimum wage the Government sets; 5, 10% on 5.6 commissions, consultancy and other service fees. Art. 39: salary tax remitted by the 20th of the next month. Art. 48 (non-residents): 10% of total income on 2.1 pay to committee members, artists, athletes and others; 5% on 3.2 copyright, patent and trademark fees. Art. 50: the yearly return by 31 March of the next year. Art. 74: in force from 1 September 2025, after the President promulgates it by decree and it is published in the Official Gazette.]

sources.title: Law on Value Added Tax (amended) No. 60/NA of 28 June 2024, Lao Official Gazette, entry 2345, published 11-03-2025 (scan, read against the page images)
sources.said: ມາດຕາ 33 (ປັບປຸງ) ການເຂົ້າໃນລະບົບອາກອນມູນຄ່າເພີ່ມ ບຸກຄົນ, ນິຕິບຸກຄົນ ຫຼື ການຈັດຕັ້ງ ທີ່ໄດ້ຂຶ້ນທະບຽນວິສາຫະກິດ ພ້ອມທັງໄດ້ຮັບເລກປະຈຳຕົວຜູ້ເສຍອາກອນ ແລະ ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດດຳເນີນທຸລະກິດ ຈາກຂະແໜງການທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ ຕ້ອງໄດ້ເຂົ້າໃນລະບົບ ອມພ. ສຳລັບ ການເຂົ້າໃນລະບົບ ອມພ ຂອງຈຸລະວິສາຫະກິດ ໄດ້ກຳນົດໄວ້ໃນລະບຽບການຕ່າງຫາກ. [Art. 33: a person, legal person or organisation registered as an enterprise, with a taxpayer number and a business licence, must enter the VAT system; micro-enterprises' entry is set by a separate regulation.]
